projectsData.title: Pokéntology
projectsData.description: An ontology-based system to represent and explore the Pokémon universe through semantic web technologies. It models Pokémon, regions, moves, items, types, and their relationships using RDF and OWL, supporting SPARQL queries, semantic reasoning, ontology management, and interactive graph visualization.
